authority.runtime: completed receipt execution.launch_argv, joined to the exact request
authority.labels: diagnostic labels; never evidence of CFL, dt or output cadence

isolation_rules.half_cfl: same source/grid and output control; explicit runtime CFL/dt difference required
isolation_rules.half_output: same source/grid and timestep control; explicit runtime tout difference required
isolation_rules.missing_runtime_token: BLOCKED; XML declaration or variant label cannot prove actual execution control

scope.read: bounded JSON request/receipt and bounded generated XML
